specs.title: example-helloworld-dylib
aligned: FR-1: Export a #[no_mangle] function named create_component (src/lib.rs:20-21)
FR-2: create_component returns a ComponentRef wrapping a HelloWorldComponent (src/lib.rs:21-24)
FR-3: Returned component supports IGreeter via query_interface (verified end-to-end via apps/dynamic-loading-example/src/main.rs:75-76)
NFR-1: Must be compiled as crate-type = ["dylib"] (Cargo.toml:9)
NFR-2: Host and dylib must use the same rustc version (documented in src/lib.rs:9-10)
NFR-3: No C-ABI shim or FFI boundary required (no unsafe/#[repr(C)] in src/lib.rs)

drifted.spec_text: spec.md:15-17 and FR-4 (spec.md:42): 'Because both the dylib and the host binary dynamically link the same component-core and example-helloworld shared libraries, TypeId values remain consistent across the dylib boundary' / 'TypeId consistency is maintained by dynamically linking shared dependencies.' plan.md:16-27 architecture diagram also shows component-core.so and example-helloworld.so as shared deps.
drifted.actual: Neither component-core nor example-helloworld declares crate-type = ["dylib"] (no [lib] section in either Cargo.toml, default is rlib-only). Clean rebuild + ldd on target/debug/libexample_helloworld_dylib.so shows only libgcc_s.so.1, libc.so.6, ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 as dynamic deps (no component_core/example_helloworld .so). nm confirms component_core/example_helloworld symbols are statically linked directly into the .so. ldd + nm on target/debug/dynamic-loading-example show the same: an independent, separately-embedded static copy, no shared .so dependency. TypeId consistency in practice comes from both sides using the same rustc version (NFR-2), not from dynamic linking.

conflicts.description: plan.md's Architecture diagram (lines 16-27) restates the same 'shared deps: component-core.so, example-helloworld.so' claim as spec.md's Overview/FR-4; both design artifacts are mutually consistent but diverge from the actual build graph (see drifted FR-4 above).

tasks.md's unresolved checklist item 'Validate that the dylib is exercised by at least one integration test in the workspace' — apps/dynamic-loading-example/src/main.rs is a demo fn main() binary with no #[test], not run under cargo test; the dylib-loading path has no automated test coverage.
